title: TRUWILD
q: truwild outdoor-athlete supplement brand, founder-led and growing. the bestseller wild greens pdp has live, demo-able bugs: a subscribe & save price that renders as $0.00/serving and a mixed £/$ currency display. founder zac curhan is highly reachable (dtc/operator podcasts, active linkedin, publicly weighing investment) and the brand is in a scaling moment. supplements truwild.com subscribe & save per-serving price renders as $0.00 per serving on the wild greens pdp the highest-ltv action (subscription) on a daily consumable shows a broken/placeholder price, killing trust and subscribe conversion. mixed-currency display: main price localizes to gbp (about 25.77 pounds) while per-serving costs are hardcoded in usd (about $0.98/serving) inconsistent currency at the decision point confuses buyers and erodes trust. copy/template error: a benefits block on the wild greens page is headed for the wrong product (it still reads as the hydrate section) a visible wrong-product header signals low cro attention and undermines credibility. social proof (293 reviews, 4.8 stars) sits far below a very long pdp, not beside the buy box proof is not visible at the decision point, costing conversion. zac curhan co-founder & ceo top [{"h":"why this is a good lead","blocks":[{"p":"truwild sells whole-food supplements (wild greens, hydrate, motion, adaptogens) to outdoor athletes across dtc, amazon, walmart.com and ~110 specialty retailers. bootstrapped since 2017 and growing fast enough to be publicly weighing outside investment.","why":"the bestseller pdp has concrete, fixable conversion bugs (a broken subscribe price, mixed-currency display, a wrong-product section header), the founder is unusually accessible, and the timing (an active growth/scaling moment) is right."}]}]

title: Clean Simple Eats
q: clean simple eats ~$21.6m/yr protein & nutrition brand, bootstrapped and founder-led. functional but dated theme with a clear money leak: bestseller flavors are sold out and the back-in-stock capture looks paused, so proven demand bounces with no waitlist. strong revenue and reachable founders (erika & jj peterson); the highest-leverage fix is demand capture on sold-out hero skus. supplements cleansimpleeats.com bestseller flavors are sold out (the pdp shows this flavor sold out fast) and back-in-stock capture appears paused (products.json shows bis-paused tags) proven demand on hero skus bounces with no waitlist/email capture, losing both sales and first-party data on a high-revenue consumable. subscribe-and-save is not surfaced at the buy box on the consumable pdp (subscription exists per products.json tags but is not prominent above the fold) under-monetizes recurring revenue on daily-use products; subscription is the main ltv lever for supplements. heavy distressed/grunge display type across headers reduces legibility and scannability, especially on mobile readability friction on the primary conversion path. logo lockup renders the eats wordmark inside a black block that reads as an unpolished/placeholder treatment minor first-impression/brand-polish issue at the top of every page. erika peterson co-founder solid [{"h":"why this is a good lead","blocks":[{"p":"clean simple eats sells protein powders, hydration and wellness products dtc plus retail and a branded cse+ app. bootstrapped from personal debt to an estimated eight figures, founded ~2014.","why":"revenue clears six figures/mo comfortably, the founders are public and reachable, and there is a concrete, fixable win (capture demand on sold-out bestsellers) rather than only cosmetic theme gripes."}]}]
